title: State of an a2dlc run (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/state.json, not committed)
description: The state machine is linear (protocol §5) with two bounded loops inside a stage. A stage ends in done with its artifact, in skipped with the reason (role not configured, the mode does not require it), or in failed/escalated with the escalation that stopped it. Resuming means running again: the core skips the done stages whose artifact is still on disk with the recorded hash and continues from the first one missing. It is outside the tree_hash.

spent_tokens.description: Sum of the tokens the CLIs reported (input_tokens, cache included, plus output_tokens). Roles without a report do not add.

spent_cache_read_tokens.description: Sum of cache_read_input_tokens the CLIs reported. Already inside spent_tokens: it is a breakdown, not an addition.

spent_cache_creation_tokens.description: Sum of cache_creation_input_tokens the CLIs reported. Already inside spent_tokens: it is a breakdown, not an addition.

spent_usd.description: Sum of what the CLIs reported. Roles without a report do not add: unreported_roles lists them.

by_role.description: Breakdown of spent_usd by role (reported only). Optional: earlier runs do not have it.

reason.description: Required with skipped, failed and escalated.

artifact.description: Artifact the stage leaves, relative to .a2dlc/run/<slice>/, with its hash: it is what resume checks.

iterations.description: Rounds of the stage loop (Tier 0 ≤ max_inner_iterations; Tier 1 ≤ max_tier1_adversarial_rounds).

outcome.description: null while it runs. PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE is the oracle's verdict at the end; escalated, when a circuit breaker stopped the run and is waiting for a person.
